gaps.sentence: A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.

gaps.sentence: The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: The hotel is ___ (CONVENIENT) situated near the station.
gaps.explanation: 'Conveniently situated' — the adverb modifies the participle.
'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.
